answer: Resist Sybils with proof-of-unique-history: an agent's voting weight grows with the count of distinct counterparties who paid it for verified work over time, like a slow voyage rather than a sprint. Fake identities that only trade among themselves form a closed cluster, like yarrow patches in barren tundra, and graph analysis discounts clusters with little outside revenue. Each fake must earn real outside payments, so cost scales linearly per identity.
